AssessmentSystem.add_course_score:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Update the specified course score in an existing student's courses mapping only if the student name is present in self.students." add_course_score]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> name </REF>: string "The student name to look up in self.students."
        <REF> course </REF>: string "The course key to add or update in the student's courses mapping."
        <REF> score </REF>: data "The score value to assign to the specified course."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether name is a key in self.students. RESULT student_exists]
            [COMMAND If student_exists is true, assign score to self.students[name]['courses'][course], adding the course entry if absent or updating it if present. RESULT updated_course_score]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: name is not a key in self.students]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do nothing and leave self.students unchanged. RESULT no_action]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AssessmentSystem.get_gpa:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return the average of a named student's recorded course values when the student exists and has at least one course, otherwise return None." get_gpa]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> name </REF>: string "The student name to look up in self.students."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number_or_null "The student's average course value if the student exists and has a non-empty courses collection; otherwise None."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether name exists as a key in self.students, and only if it does, check whether self.students[name]['courses'] is non-empty using short-circuit evaluation. RESULT student_exists_and_has_courses]
            [COMMAND If student_exists_and_has_courses is true, return the sum of self.students[name]['courses'].values() divided by len(self.students[name]['courses']). RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: name is not in self.students or self.students[name]['courses'] is empty]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None immediately. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AssessmentSystem.get_all_students_with_f:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return the names of students who have at least one course score below 60." get_all_students_with_fail_course]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "A list of student names that have at least one course score below 60."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list named students to collect matching student names. RESULT students]
            [COMMAND For each name and student record in self.students, iterate through that student's courses and scores. RESULT student_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the inner course loop, if a score is strictly less than 60, append the student's name to students and stop checking further courses for that student. RESULT students]
            [COMMAND After processing all students, return the students list. RESULT students]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AssessmentSystem.get_course_average:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Compute the average non-None score for a specified course across all students and return None when no valid scores are found." get_course_average]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> course </REF>: any "The course identifier to look up in each student's course mapping."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number_or_null "The average of all non-None scores for the specified course, or None if no student has a valid score for that course."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize total to 0 and count to 0 before scanning student records. RESULT total_count_initialized]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each student in self.students.values(). RESULT student_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for each student, check whether the given course exists as a key in student['courses']. RESULT course_presence_checked]
            [COMMAND When the course key exists for the current student, read score from student['courses'][course]. RESULT score]
            [COMMAND For the current student, if score is not None, add score to total and increment count by 1. RESULT running_total_and_count_updated]
            [COMMAND After all students have been processed, return total divided by count if count is greater than 0. RESULT average]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: After processing all students, count is equal to 0.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None instead of performing division because no valid non-None score was found for the specified course. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
AssessmentSystem.get_top_student:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Iterate through all students, compute each student's GPA, and return the name of the student with the highest non-None GPA above the initial baseline of 0." get_top_student]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Object instance containing the students collection and the GPA lookup method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> top_student </REF>: string_or_none "The name of the student with the highest non-None GPA strictly greater than 0, or None if no student satisfies that condition."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize top_student to None as the default result when no qualifying student is found. RESULT top_student]
            [COMMAND Initialize top_gpa to 0 as the comparison baseline for selecting a higher GPA. RESULT top_gpa]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each key-value pair produced by self.students.items(), assigning the key to name and the value to student. RESULT name, student]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for the current name, compute gpa by calling self.get_gpa(name). RESULT gpa]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop iteration, evaluate whether gpa is not None and, only if that is true, whether gpa is strictly greater than top_gpa. RESULT gpa_is_valid_and_higher]
            [COMMAND If both conditions are true for the current iteration, update top_gpa to gpa. RESULT top_gpa]
            [COMMAND If both conditions are true for the current iteration, update top_student to name. RESULT top_student]
            [COMMAND After all loop iterations complete without any early exit, return top_student. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During a loop iteration, gpa is None.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do not evaluate the strict greater-than comparison against top_gpa because the condition uses short-circuit and. RESULT no_update]
            [COMMAND Leave top_gpa and top_student unchanged and continue to the next student. RESULT state_preserved]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During a loop iteration, gpa is not None but gpa is less than or equal to top_gpa.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do not update top_gpa because the current GPA is not strictly greater than the tracked maximum. RESULT top_gpa_unchanged]
            [COMMAND Do not update top_student, which preserves the earlier student in tie cases because equality does not satisfy the strict boundary. RESULT top_student_unchanged]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The students collection is empty, or no student has a non-None GPA strictly greater than 0 across all iterations.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Keep the initialized values unchanged throughout execution. RESULT top_student=None, top_gpa=0]
            [COMMAND Return None as the final result. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
